::: {.callout-note}
## Course Portal: CIE IGCSE Mathematics (0580)
Welcome, students! This specialized academic portal provides in-depth resources for the Cambridge International GCSE Mathematics (0580) curriculum. Here, you will find exhaustive syllabus checklists, revision notes, targeted practice question banks, and official exam information—all mathematically formatted to optimize your learning and help you achieve an A*.
:::

## 1 Course Introduction

<p><strong>Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics (0580)</strong> is a structured and comprehensive academic curriculum designed to develop mathematical skills, logical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities. The syllabus is divided into two tiers of entry: <strong>Core Tier</strong> (eligible for grades C–G) and <strong>Extended Tier</strong> (eligible for grades A*–E), offering appropriate routes of assessment for students of different abilities.</p>

**Assessment Objectives (AOs) Weightings:**
* **AO1 (Knowledge and understanding of mathematical techniques):** Core 60–70% | Extended 40–50%
* **AO2 (Analyse, interpret and communicate mathematically):** Core 30–40% | Extended 50–60%

### Syllabus Structure

<p>The Cambridge IGCSE Mathematics syllabus content is categorized into 9 major topics, covering core concepts for all students with extended high-level parts for the Extended Tier:</p>

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 1 Number
**1.1** Types of number<br/>
**1.2** Sets<br/>
**1.3** Powers and roots<br/>
**1.4** Fractions, decimals and percentages<br/>
**1.5** Ordering<br/>
**1.6** The four operations<br/>
**1.7** Indices I<br/>
**1.8** Standard form<br/>
**1.9** Estimation<br/>
**1.10** Limits of accuracy<br/>
**1.11** Ratio and proportion<br/>
**1.12** Rates<br/>
**1.13** Percentages<br/>
**1.14** Using a calculator<br/>
**1.15** Time<br/>
**1.16** Money<br/>
**1.17** Exponential growth and decay (Extended only)<br/>
**1.18** Surds (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 2 Algebra and graphs
**2.1** Introduction to algebra<br/>
**2.2** Algebraic manipulation<br/>
**2.3** Algebraic fractions (Extended only)<br/>
**2.4** Indices II<br/>
**2.5** Equations<br/>
**2.6** Inequalities<br/>
**2.7** Sequences<br/>
**2.8** Proportion (Extended only)<br/>
**2.9** Graphs in practical situations<br/>
**2.10** Graphs of functions<br/>
**2.11** Sketching curves<br/>
**2.12** Differentiation (Extended only)<br/>
**2.13** Functions (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 3 Coordinate geometry
**3.1** Coordinates<br/>
**3.2** Drawing linear graphs<br/>
**3.3** Gradient of linear graphs<br/>
**3.4** Length and midpoint (Extended only)<br/>
**3.5** Equations of linear graphs<br/>
**3.6** Parallel lines<br/>
**3.7** Perpendicular lines (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 4 Geometry
**4.1** Geometrical terms<br/>
**4.2** Geometrical constructions<br/>
**4.3** Scale drawings<br/>
**4.4** Similarity<br/>
**4.5** Symmetry<br/>
**4.6** Angles<br/>
**4.7** Circle theorems I<br/>
**4.8** Circle theorems II (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 5 Mensuration
**5.1** Units of measure<br/>
**5.2** Area and perimeter<br/>
**5.3** Circles, arcs and sectors<br/>
**5.4** Surface area and volume<br/>
**5.5** Compound shapes and parts of shapes<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 6 Trigonometry
**6.1** Pythagoras' theorem<br/>
**6.2** Right-angled triangles<br/>
**6.3** Exact trigonometric values (Extended only)<br/>
**6.4** Trigonometric functions (Extended only)<br/>
**6.5** Non-right-angled triangles (Extended only)<br/>
**6.6** Pythagoras' theorem and trigonometry in 3D (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 7 Transformations and vectors
**7.1** Transformations<br/>
**7.2** Vectors in two dimensions (Extended only)<br/>
**7.3** Magnitude of a vector (Extended only)<br/>
**7.4** Vector geometry (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 8 Probability
**8.1** Introduction to probability<br/>
**8.2** Relative and expected frequencies<br/>
**8.3** Probability of combined events<br/>
**8.4** Conditional probability (Extended only)<br/>
:::

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## 9 Statistics
**9.1** Classifying statistical data<br/>
**9.2** Interpreting statistical data<br/>
**9.3** Averages and measures of spread<br/>
**9.4** Statistical charts and diagrams<br/>
**9.5** Scatter diagrams<br/>
**9.6** Cumulative frequency diagrams (Extended only)<br/>
**9.7** Histograms (Extended only)<br/>
:::
